reason: The named lab and the batch report behind the QR code are what I look for, and the dose is on the box. With the money-back guarantee, one box at $24.99 is a fair test, and pre-counted sachets would be handy on my work trips.
objection: Individual foil sachets feel like more packaging waste, and I want to open the lab report and see it matches the batch number before I trust it. I would also want to read real reviews first, and there are none yet on a first batch.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report on the product page turned out to be generic, missing, or not matching the batch number, I would not buy.
